parsed.reply: «La balsa» is moderately common. You will hear it when talking about river rafting, makeshift boats, or sometimes metaphorically (like being in the same boat, «estar en la misma balsa» or more commonly «en el mismo barco»). For everyday transport it is less common than «barco» or «bote», but it's the exact word for a raft.
